svg.title: WharfSWE passing trials by Copilot CLI revision
svg.desc: Selected WharfSWE models, with one point per completed 56-trial arm. X is the revision of CLI 1.0.x; Y shows Passing trials (out of 56). The X axis starts at revision 95. Y axis: 48 to 56. Lines join observed runs only.
